item.title: What engineering managers need to own as AI changes delivery
item.description:
I think engineering management built mainly around status tracking is becoming harder to justify.

That is narrower than saying managers are disappearing. Someone still has to set priorities, develop people, resolve disagreements, and take responsibility when a technically successful project produces little business value.

item.title: When I still choose a relational database
item.description:
In 2013, I wrote RDBMS vs. NOSQL? because database advice was getting ahead of database requirements.

I still start with a relational database for many product backends. Users, accounts, permissions, orders, and configuration usually have relationships and invariants that fit the model well.

item.title: Identity systems fail socially before they fail cryptographically
item.description:

The protocol matters. So do the decisions around it: who counts as the same person, who can grant access, what logout means, and who removes privileges when someone's role changes.
